sentences.text: This appeal by the claimant under section 173(1) of the Motor Vehicles Act is arising out of the award dated 15.11.2022 passed by 25th MACT, Indore in Claim Case No.1375/2019 seeking enhancement of compensation amount awarded by the Tribunal.
2. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Tribunal in this regard are also not in question.

As per the findings of the Tribunal,
for the permanent disability suffered by the appellant, the Tribunal has awarded a total compensation of Rs.5,46,844/- along with interest.

The breakup of the compensation amount is as under:

Loss of income during treatment-Rs.18,000/-
 Medical expenses -Rs.1,59,844/-
 Pain & suffering -Rs.20,000/-
 Loss of amenities -Rs.20,000/-
 Attendant/special diet etc. -Rs.5,000/-

 TOTAL Rs.5,46,844/-

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the Tribunal has committed an error in not awarding just and proper amount of compensation in the case as the amount awarded by the Tribunal is on the lower side.
He further submits that the income of the appellant assessed by the Tribunal is on the lower side considering the minimum wages prescribed for an unskilled labour at the relevant period.
Considering the age of the appellant at the time of accident, the future prospects ought to have been assessed at the rate of 40% instead of 25% as assessed by the tribunal.
The tribunal has not awarded any sum under the head of loss of income during treatment.
The appellant underwent prolonged treatment.
The compensation awarded under the other conventional heads is also on the meager side.
The permanent disability assessed by the tribunal is also on the lower side which deserves to be enhanced for calculating just and proper amount of compensation in the case.
Hence, prayed for just and proper amount of compensation in the case.

4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the Insurance Company has argued in support of the impugned award and contended that the Claims Tribunal has rightly awarded the compensation amount in the case which does not call for any interference by this Court.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
6.
After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, I find substance in the arguments advanced by the counsel for the appellant.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the arguments advanced by the counsel for the parties and the evidence that came on record, in the considered opinion of this court, the compensation awarded by the tribunal deserves to be modified as under:
 HEAD AMOUNT  Permanent disability -Rs.5,57,550/-
 (i.e Rs.7375 40% FP x 12 x 18 x 25/100 PD)
 Conventional heads i.e. special diet/
 transportation/pain and suffering/ loss  of income during treatment etc. -Rs.1,00,000/-

TOTAL Rs.8,17,394/-
Rohit vs Arjun on 10 May, 2024
Indian

Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/62086984/
2 7.
Thus, the just and proper amount of compensation in the instant case is Rs.8,17,394/- as against the award of the Tribunal of Rs.5,46,844/-.
Accordingly, the appellants are entitled to an additional sum of Rs.2,70,550/- over and above the amount which has been awarded by the Tribunal.
8. In the result, the appeal is partly allowed by enhancing the compensation amount by a sum of Rs.2,70,550/-.
The enhanced amount shall bear interest at the same rate as awarded by the Tribunal.
The other findings recorded by the Tribunal shall remain intact.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE hk/
